decision.rationale: D18 interprets evidence only; evolution and production decisions belong to downstream gates.

findings.claim: The D16 deployment serves the v2 implementation's API contract (readiness, registration, login, task lifecycle).
findings.scope: Single loopback deployment, one seeded workspace, one workload.

findings.claim: Invalid credentials are rejected (401) while valid credentials authenticate (200).
findings.scope: One user, one wrong-password case; no brute-force/lockout scope.

findings.claim: Workspace membership and admin role are enforced at the HTTP boundary (member forbidden 403, admin permitted 201, permitted operation 201).
findings.scope: Behavioral evidence only; the policy-boundary proof is D15's.

findings.claim: A non-member caller is isolated from workspace state (403).
findings.scope: Single outsider, single workspace; general isolation posture beyond this case is UNKNOWN.

findings.claim: State survives restart in both directions: created state persists and pre-restart deletion stays deleted.
findings.scope: One restart, one store, file-backed backend only.

findings.claim: Lifecycle events are emitted with required producer and type fields (svc-task, task-created/task-updated).
findings.scope: Store-level read of one workload's events; no stream/ordering claims beyond the recorded set.

findings.claim: Recorded evidence contains no secret shapes or raw credential strings.
findings.scope: Shape-scan scope only; absence of shapes is not a full audit.

findings.claim: Latency was measured mechanically; no performance conclusion follows from these values.
findings.scope: Deliberate non-finding: loopback timing proves nothing about production performance.

findings.claim: All 18 observations resolved PASS with 0 FAIL, 0 UNDETERMINED, 0 BLOCKED.
findings.scope: Bounded workload only: no concurrency, no multi-workspace, no long-run, no adversarial scope.

findings.claim: The real evolution decision stands at NO_CHANGE and production authorization remains false; nothing observed authorizes evolution or production.
findings.scope: Constitutional reading of evidence metadata, not a runtime measurement.

unknowns: Production behavior (network, load, persistence at scale).
Performance characteristics under any real workload.
Whether observed behavior would reproduce on another backend.
Whether any finding would change under adversarial input.
